settings.heading: How to prepare
settings.content: Add 2 heaped scoops (about 32g) to roughly 200ml of cold or warm milk. Shake or blend for 10 seconds and drink.

settings.heading: Allergens & storage
settings.content:
Contains oats, nuts and soy. Manufactured in a facility that also processes dairy and whey.

Store in an airtight container in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. Best before 90 days from packaging.

settings.heading: Shipping & returns
settings.content: Orders are dispatched within 24-48 hours and typically delivered in 3-6 working days across India. Sealed pouches can be returned within 7 days of delivery if unopened.
